# Artifact Keeper 1.11.12

A maintenance release on the 1.11 line: 25 changelog entries from 25 pull requests since 1.11.11, all landed on `main` first and brought to the line in #5247, #5248, #5299, #5302, #5306, #5308, #5310, #5319, #5328, #5355, #5357, #5358, #5359, #5360, #5361, #5362, #5371, #5381, #5382, #5383, #5392, #5426, #5430, #5437 and #5441 (#5249 carries a release workflow and ships nothing). Four are security fixes: **zip moves to 9.1.2 for GHSA-m665-v7pm-7grj (critical)** (#5440, in #5441), **the event stream and the peer and transfer reads are scoped to the caller** (#5393, in #5437), **a refused Azure signature no longer puts the source SAS into error messages** (#5181, in #5247), and **repository create applies the quarantine settings instead of dropping them** (#5324, in #5358). Most of the rest fix format clients that failed outright: **Hugging Face `snapshot_download` against hosted repositories and through Remotes** (#5280, #5321, #5322, #5323), **`puppet module install`** (#5229), **Alpine `APKINDEX` package identity and provider priority** (#5254, #5320), **Cargo renamed dependencies** (#5227), **RPM source packages** (#5278), **Helm upstream indexes with unversioned dependencies** (#5277) and **npm scoped tarballs with an encoded slash** (#5221). **Full backups work on filesystem storage again** (#5053). **One schema migration**: migration 330 changes a column default, and the line moves from migration 289 to 330. There are no new settings, and the scanner adapter stays at 1.5.2.

## Security

- **zip moved to 9.1.2 for GHSA-m665-v7pm-7grj (critical)** (#5440, in #5441). zip 9.0.4 and earlier let the local file header and the central directory disagree, so one archive could show different entries to different readers. The backend parses uploaded NuGet, VS Code extension, PyPI wheel, Composer, Go, Swift, Terraform and conda archives, WASM plugins and Artifactory imports with this crate. The change is lockfile-only.
- **The event stream and the peer and transfer reads are scoped to the caller** (#5393, in #5437). `GET /api/v1/events/stream` used to forward every domain event to any signed-in user. A non-administrator now receives only the events of repositories it may read, without the actor. The `GET` routes under `/api/v1/peers` now require an administrator, like their mutations.
- **A refused Azure signature no longer puts the source SAS into error messages and logs** (#5181, in #5247). Azure errors now report the status, error codes and request id, never the response body, for every Azure blob operation.
- **Repository create applies `quarantine_enabled` and `quarantine_duration_minutes`** (#5324, in #5358). They were silently dropped, so a repository created with quarantine on served its first uploads unheld until a `PATCH`.

## What changed

- **Hugging Face.** `snapshot_download` works against a hosted repository: model info has the Hub's shape and the synthetic commit resolves (#5280, in #5328). Through a Remote it now gets files in subdirectories, because the tree listing forwards `recursive`, `expand` and the cursor (#5321, in #5357). A cold `HEAD` on a Remote no longer downloads the whole file and throws it away, so each new file is fetched once instead of twice; this covers every format on the shared Remote download path (#5322, in #5359). A gated model raises `GatedRepoError` instead of being retried as a `502` (#5323, in #5360).
- **Format clients.** `puppet module install` works: `GET /v3/releases` lists releases in the Forge v3 shape (#5229, in #5382). Alpine `APKINDEX` lists each package under its own `.PKGINFO` name and version with its `k:` and `i:` fields, and repairs older entries on the next index request (#5254, in #5299). A package uploaded through the generic `PUT` endpoint is named and indexed as its format's own upload route would do it (#5320, in #5362). A crate with a renamed dependency builds from a Cargo registry (#5227, in #5302). RPM repodata lists source RPMs as `src` (#5278, in #5306). A Remote Helm repository serves upstream indexes whose dependencies have no `version` (#5277, in #5308). npm serves a scoped tarball requested with an encoded slash (#5221, in #5392).
- **Backups.** Full backups read artifact bytes from each repository's own storage path, so they no longer fail with `backup is missing artifact content` on filesystem storage (#5053, in #5355).
- **API.** Artifact listings report an exact `pagination.total` on `page=N` requests and flag lower-bound totals with `total_is_exact` (#5255, in #5319). `GET /api/v1/search/advanced` applies its repository, path, version, size and date filters (#5200, in #5426). `promotion-history` honours `artifact_id` (#5209, in #5381). A rejected `PATCH /api/v1/repositories/{key}` changes nothing (#5201, in #5310).
- **Signing.** A Debian repository whose signing key cannot produce OpenPGP answers `409` instead of `500` or the wrong key (#5198, in #5248). Artifact signing works for a repository set up with `sign_packages: true`, and the `409` names what is missing (#5208, in #5383).
- **Peers.** A peer subscription or sync policy can no longer be created in the `pull` mode, which never replicated anything; an omitted mode is `push` (#5293, in #5361).
- **Scanning and the age gate.** Scanning a Maven JAR no longer grades the `provided` and `test` dependencies declared in its embedded build POM (#5262, in #5430). The age-gate `451` carries `Cache-Control: no-store`, so a cache cannot keep refusing a version after it is released (#5356, in #5371).

## Upgrade notes

Migration 330 sets the default of `peer_repo_subscriptions.replication_mode` to `push`. It is the same file as on `main`, so the migration ledger stays consistent with 1.12. There is no new or changed setting. Behaviours operators may notice:

- Creating a peer subscription or sync policy with `replication_mode: pull` now answers `400`. Existing `pull` subscriptions and policies are left as they are, logged once at startup, and reported with `effective: inactive`; recreate them as `push` or `mirror` if they were meant to replicate.
- A non-administrator's event stream carries only the events of repositories it may read, and the `GET` routes under `/api/v1/peers` now refuse a non-administrator. `GET /api/v1/peers` still answers `200` with no peers, so peer heartbeats keep working.
- `POST /api/v1/repositories` refuses the update-only settings it does not apply (a non-empty `release_repository_key`, `curation_enabled: true`, a `curation_default_action` other than `allow`) with `400` instead of ignoring them. Set them with `PATCH` after creating the repository.
- Artifact listings run the exact count by default on `page=N` requests. `?cursor=` walks keep the cheap total, and `?count=lower_bound` restores it for page requests.
- `GET /api/v1/search/advanced` answers `400` for an unparseable `created_after` or `created_before` instead of ignoring it.
- Binding a signing key that cannot produce OpenPGP to a Debian, RPM or pacman repository now answers `400`. An existing binding keeps working until it is changed.
- The Puppet `file_uri` is now relative to the repository root, as the Forge's is.
- A generic `PUT` of a package whose control file, `package.json` or wheel `METADATA` names another package or version than its path is refused with `400`. Packages uploaded before this release keep their rows; upload them again to re-index them.
- `ak_proxy_cache_lookups_total` now counts the streaming proxy path, `HEAD` and `GET` alike, so proxy cache hit ratios on dashboards will change.

The full entries are in the `## [1.11.12]` section of [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/artifact-keeper/artifact-keeper/blob/v1.11.12/CHANGELOG.md).
